tasks.description: Load the CSV, parse timestamps to datetime, enforce float types for temperature and humidity, and verify 5-minute sampling intervals.
Compute Humidex from temperature and relative humidity and assign comfort categories (e.g., comfortable, some discomfort, great discomfort).
Calculate Thom’s Discomfort Index (DI) using temperature and humidity and label comfort risk levels.
Resample 5-minute readings to hourly and compute mean, min, and max for temperature_c and humidity_percent.
Predict the next 60-minute average temperature and humidity using simple exponential smoothing (EWMA) over the last N readings.
Compute dew point temperature (°C) from temperature_c and humidity_percent using the Magnus formula.
Calculate Vapor Pressure Deficit (kPa) from temperature_c and humidity_percent using saturation vapor pressure minus actual vapor pressure.
Flag sudden changes using 5-minute deltas (e.g., |ΔT| > 0.8°C or |ΔRH| > 3%) to indicate potential system issues.
Detect potential sensor stuck conditions when temperature or humidity varies less than a small epsilon for K consecutive intervals.
Aggregate total time spent in each comfort category using outputs from existing comfort indices (Humidex/Thom) over rolling windows (e.g., 1h, 24h).
